en.headline: Airport cannabis case reaches court after 6kg seizure
en.dek: A 38-year-old mainland passenger arrested at Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday is due at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts today on drug-trafficking and poison charges.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers on Saturday intercepted a 38-year-old mainland man arriving from Bangkok and found about six kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, valued at about HK$1.3 million, in his carry-on baggage, together with two boxes of products containing suspected Part I poisons.

The man was arrested at the airport and later charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug and one count of possessing a Part I poison. Customs said the case would be mentioned at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday.

The department said it would keep targeting passengers from higher-risk routes and warned the public not to carry unknown items for other people. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment. Unauthorised possession of a Part I poison can bring a fine of HK$100,000 and two years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 機場檢六公斤懷疑大麻花 內地男今日提堂
zh.dek: 海關周六在香港國際機場拘捕一名38歲內地男旅客，檢獲約六公斤懷疑大麻花及懷疑第一部毒藥產品，案件今日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，周六在香港國際機場偵破一宗行李藏毒案，一名38歲內地男旅客由泰國曼谷抵港，人員在其隨身行李檢獲約六公斤懷疑大麻花，市值約130萬元，另有兩盒含有懷疑第一部毒藥的產品，其後把該男子拘捕。
被捕人士被控一項販運危險藥物罪及一項管有第一部毒藥罪，海關指案件於今日（七日）在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續按風險管理抽查高風險地區抵港旅客，並提醒市民不要接受他人委託運送來歷不明物品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁；根據《藥劑業及毒藥條例》，未按規定管有毒藥表第1部所列毒藥，最高可被判罰款10萬元及監禁兩年。
